_meta.description: Vanilla Morrowind equipment reference (armor, weapons, clothing incl. rings/amulets) parsed directly from the game's ESM files (Morrowind + Tribunal + Bloodmoon, later files override earlier). Purpose: ground NP-vs-vanilla item comparisons and answer vanilla stat lookups without memory or wiki dependence. This file describes VANILLA values only — never valid NP values.

conventions.ar_base: The raw ESM armor rating — the tooltip value at armor skill 30. Player tooltip at skill S = floor(ar_base x S/30); at skill 100 = floor(ar_base x 10/3). NP's items.json stores AR at the skill-100 convention, so to compare: vanillaAR@100 = floor(ar_base x 100/30).
conventions.enchant_capacity: Displayed (CS/tooltip) enchant points; the ESM stores this x10 and it is divided back here.
conventions.speed: Weapon swing-speed multiplier (1.0 = baseline). NP tooltips express this as a percentage (e.g. 2.5 -> 250%).
conventions.dmg: [min,max] per swing type. Constant-effect enchantments have type 'constant'; per-effect duration values on constant enchants are engine artifacts and not meaningful.
conventions.ids: id is a slug of the display name; display-name collisions get an --esm-id suffix. esm_id is the authoritative game object id.

s-esm.note: Parsed from local Morrowind.esm / Tribunal.esm / Bloodmoon.esm — the shipped game data itself.
